content.text: In regions where traditional payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal are unavailable, digital creators face significant barriers to monetizing their work. Whether you are in Nigeria, Venezuela, or Zimbabwe, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/building-crypto-store-cloudflare-pages-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-selling-beats-online-17|Everything You]]-you-need-23|building]] a digital store that can process crypto payments is essential. This guide walks you through deploying a digital store on Cloudflare Pages at no cost, ensuring you can sell your digital products without relying on restrictive platforms. You will learn how to set up a robust [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-selling-digital-downloads-pakistan-stripe|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]] that empowers you to take control of your online sales.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The COREMERCH infrastructure is designed for resilience in a digital economy where platforms often impose restrictions. With Stack 01, you leverage GitHub Pages and Apps Script to establish a fast and reliable store without the dependence on external payment processors. This setup allows you to circumvent the limitations of conventional financial systems, ensuring you maintain full ownership of your data and customer transactions. By utilizing NOWPayments for crypto transactions, you can accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies while avoiding the high fees associated with traditional services.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you begin deployment, gather the necessary resources to ensure a smooth process. You will need a GitHub account to host your store, as well as a Google account for Apps Script. Prepare your digital products, ensuring they meet the format requirements for delivery. Familiarize yourself with the NOWPayments integration process, and make sure to have your crypto wallet set up to receive payments. Understanding these components will streamline your deployment and help you avoid common pitfalls that can delay the launch of your store.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by configuring your GitHub Pages to host your store. Use the Sovereign Blueprint as your guide to set up Apps Script for backend operations. Integrate NOWPayments for seamless crypto payment processing. This integration will take advantage of automatic webhooks that confirm payments instantly, allowing for prompt product delivery. Ensure that your delivery mechanism—whether using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2—is correctly linked to your payment confirmation process to provide a smooth customer experience. Testing this whole pipeline is crucial before going live.
Take control of your digital sales with complete infrastructure ownership.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your digital store is configured and tested, it's time to go live. Push your changes to GitHub Pages and monitor the deployment for any issues. As you promote your store, track the first transactions made through NOWPayments to ensure everything functions as expected. Keep communication open with your customers, and be ready to address any questions they may have about their purchases. This initial phase is critical for establishing trust and gaining insights into your store’s operational efficiency.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully deploying your digital store, consider strategies for scaling. Analyze customer feedback and transaction data to identify popular products or areas for improvement. Gradually increase your product offerings, utilizing the infrastructure you have established. If you need more advanced features, consider upgrading to the Edge Commerce Stack for enhanced capabilities, including SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configuration. This will further solidify your brand's reputation and security, allowing you to scale confidently in the digital marketplace.

The difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy Stack 02 under your accounts in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Deploy in just hours, not days, using the Sovereign Blueprint.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The setup decision comes down to time versus depth. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

Start by setting up a GitHub Pages account and Google Apps Script. Use NOWPayments for payment processing. Follow the Sovereign Blueprint for guidance. This setup allows you to sell digital products and accept payments without ongoing fees.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages and Apps Script for deployment, taking 4-6 hours. Stack 02, the Edge Commerce Stack, utilizes Cloudflare Pages and Workers, deployed in 48 hours with additional features like Supabase.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are viable options for hosting a digital product store. They provide free hosting solutions that integrate well with crypto payment processors like NOWPayments.
What are the benefits of using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments allows acceptance of over 300 cryptocurrencies with a low fee of 0.5%. It requires no KYC, enabling quick and easy transactions for your customers.
How can I ensure my digital store is secure?
Utilize SPF, DKIM, and DMARC settings to protect your email communications. Regularly update your software and monitor transactions to safeguard against potential threats.
